notes.title: Update v.02.00
notes.content:
Extra modes for more fun:
-Zombie Mode - limited time to finish each level, unlimited ammo to kill zombies xD.
-Zombie Mode No Timer - the same as Zombie Mode but without time limits.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30286087/8d4b0bce3d98326594c7ee45ab6f08d5347f1e7a.gif[/img]

Changed gameplay mechanics:
-Now you can shoot a gun!
-When guards see you they attack you it's not instantly game over.
-Controls changed to incorporate shooting a gun.
-To use an object you need to aim at it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30286087/4178ac6c22be14a20826314f5dde560ae03cb453.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30286087/65021c663413a3a035a7a82500f547e366bbde20.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update v.01.01
notes.content:
-Two new challenges: "No Timer Challenge" and "No Timer Challenge Plus" for every one who hates timers. Now you can play more carefully and sneaky without worrying about the time running out.

-Achievements for accomplishing each challenge.
